title: Breaking the Restrictions
summary: Hiding in the fog, Wang Lin breaks the Six Desire Devil Lord's last chains of restrictions with a single sword so that the two Soul Formation cultivators will fight each other. Near the summit, Duanmu Ji catches the Six Desire Devil Lord, who has slowed down to protect a disciple left behind by their own master. Duanmu Ji blames the Six Desire Devil Lord for the deadly chains of restrictions, which Wang Lin in fact set. While they argue, Wang Lin sets off the mountain's final restriction on both of them, and the two badly hurt devils retreat. Left alone, Wang Lin studies for three years and breaks every restriction on the Forbidden Mountain. Tu Si, an Ancient God of eight stars, then appears, names him the fourth Enlightened One, and gives him a jade slip on making restriction flags and a piece of the starry sky's Mojian Stone. With these he passes the main tower, where many earlier intruders took their rewards, and enters a whirlpool to the third trial, the Annihilation Realm.
